title: The Algorithmic Gaze: An Audit and Ethnography of the LAION-Aesthetics Predictor Model
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the association bias of an aesthetic scoring model (LAION Aesthetic Predictor) by calculating the pointwise mutual information (PMI) between religious identity terms appearing in image captions and the likelihood of those images being rated as 'high-aesthetic' (score ≥ 6.5).
findings: Images with captions mentioning Hindu, Buddhist, or Christian communities were more likely to be rated as high-aesthetic (score ≥ 6.5) by the LAION-Aesthetics Predictor model, while images with captions mentioning Jews or Muslims were more likely to be filtered out (rated below 6.5).
